title: 01 The History of Standard ML: Ideas, Principles, Culture
summary: An ICFP 2015 keynote on the history of Standard ML, covering its ideas, principles and culture. It traces ML from Strachey, Landin and Milner through SML's development and its interplay with OCaml.
why: Pointed to in language-history discussions as a good account of how ML and SML came to be.

quote.text: You can hear a bunch more about the full history of development of SML and interaction with OCaml here
